{{Top|leg|canon=Symbol of the Royal House of Naboo}}
<span class="invert-images">[[File:Naboo.svg|thumb|150px|The emblem of Naboo]]</span>
The '''Naboo royal crest''',<ref name="Ffp34">[[The Official Star Wars Fact File Part 34|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' Part 34]]</ref> also known as the '''Naboo emblem''', was a traditional insignia of the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]], a group of [[Human/Legends|Humans]] living on a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Naboo/Legends|same name]].<ref name="FF">{{FactFile|128|GAR 15-16|Garments and Couture}}</ref> It was originally associated with [[Grizmallt/Legends|Grizmallt]],<ref name="TPM Expanded">''[[Star Wars: The Phantom Menace: The Expanded Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> the planet from which the Human Naboo originated.<ref name="GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref> A [[Flower/Legends|flower]]-like symbol, it was frequently emblazoned upon [[Clothing/Legends|clothes]], jewels and other accessories worn by the [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|monarch of Naboo]] and their entourage.<ref name="FF" /> That emblem must have been created in ancient [[Time/Legends|times]], since it featured on an antique [[Gold/Legends|golden]] diadem that [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]] wore with her [[Padmé Amidala's wardrobe/Legends#Royal attire|traveling dress]].<ref name="TPMVD">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> Another version of the emblem was used on the belt buckles of the Queen's [[Handmaiden/Legends|handmaidens]]<ref name="FF" /> and on the vertical banners that hung on the facade of the [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Royal Palace]].<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>

That symbol was omnipresent on all things of Naboo make or related to the Naboo. When Amidala became [[Senator/Legends|senator]], her sleeping quarters aboard her [[J-type diplomatic barge/Legends|J-type diplomatic barge]] had a rug with the Naboo emblem on it.<ref name="TCW307">{{TCW|Assassin (episode)}}</ref> The stylized flower even appeared on the [[S-130 Shelter speeder]]s used protection in hazardous environments.<ref name="TCW117">{{TCW|Blue Shadow Virus (episode)}}</ref> During the [[Festival of Light/Legends|Festival of Light]] that celebrated the anniversary of the Naboo joining the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] eight hundred and forty-seven [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the emblem was featured prominently in a [[Fireworks/Legends|fireworks]] display.<ref name="TCWCrisis">{{TCW|Crisis on Naboo}}</ref> In that display, the colony [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that brought the first Human settlers on Naboo was represented by the flower-like emblem crashing on the planet's surface. It was also shown emblazoned on the coat of [[Kwilaan/Legends|Kwilaan]], the famous [[Scout/Legends|explorer]] that discovered the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]].<ref name="Crisis">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep418|text="Crisis on Naboo" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}} {{C|slide 2 caption}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Naboo_emblem.png|thumb|150px|An upside down variant of the Naboo emblem]]
According to an article published in the [[Wikipedia:Vogue (magazine)|''Vogue'']] fashion magazine, the stylized flower that was used as the Naboo symbol was inspired by [[Wikipedia:Art Nouveau|Art Nouveau]] motifs.<ref name="VM">{{WebCite|url=http://www.style.com/vogue/feature/042302/page2.html|text=Star Wars Couture|author=Phyllis Posnick|date=April 1999|work=Vogue|archivedate=20020522160632}} (Original no longer available, backup at [http://forums.thefashionspot.com/showpost.php?p=2558166&postcount=16 The Fashion Spot])</ref> It also bears resemblance<ref name="FF" /> to the [[Wikipedia:Fleur-de-lis|fleur-de-lis]], a conventionalized [[Wikipedia:Iris|iris]] in heraldry, which featured on the former royal arms of [[Wikipedia:France|France]]<ref name="FDL">{{WebCite|url=https://www.heraldica.org/topics/fdl.htm|text=The Fleur-de-lis|work=Heraldica.org|archivedate=20200507164119}}</ref> and the [[Wikipedia:flag of Quebec|flag of Quebec]].
